blocks.text: Incident: Mother's Day checkout 429 on gift-wrap app

This is the working cut for HBR-INC-2021-044 on May 11, 2021. Dana Whitlock asked for a written bound after the current path (Third-party wrap app, 429 from wrap-app.harbor.internal starting 09:52 ET) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host checkout.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on retry the wrap app on 429, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Disable the gift-wrap app on Mother's Day weekends. Wrap becomes a line item Dana adds by hand until we own the script. Do not add retries on the 429. I am not restating a hallway yes. retry the wrap app on 429 is out because Retries turned 429 into a 2.1 minute hang. 41 carts sat. Raising retries is how we made it worse at 10:18. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at minutes=17.4, carts=41, hang=2.1, start=09:52, call=10:41, orders=19, lost=1.6, app=1. Sibling tickets HBR-1104 and HBR-INC-2021-044-APP. I will not reopen retry the wrap app on 429 in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: wrap-app.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (12): refuse on retry the wrap app on 429, lock is feature flag, line-item fallback, no retry bump. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-1104.
Customers were not 'browsing.' They were stuck on gift wrap with a spinner.

What a skeptical user would try first on checkout.harbor.internal: the path Dana Whitlock actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on shop.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

blocks.text: feature flag, line-item fallback, no retry bump Host checkout.harbor.internal. Ticket HBR-INC-2021-044. Acceptor Dana Whitlock.
